Overview of Canton of Geneva Region (Genève)

Canton of Geneva Region (Genève) is located in the Canton of Geneva region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Geneva. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Jet d'Eau & Lake Geneva harbor, Vieille Ville & St. Pierre Cathedral, Palais des Nations & CERN Science Gateway, Carouge bohemian quarter.

RegionCanton of Geneva
Capital cityGeneva
Cities & municipalities19
Primary transport hubGeneva Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Canton of Geneva Region

Geneva Airport (GVA) is 7 minutes by free train from Genève-Cornavin station; TGV Lyria to Paris. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Canton of Geneva

When visiting cities across Canton of Geneva, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Filets de perche
  • Longeole sausage
  • Cardons épineux genevois
  • Artisanal Swiss watchmakers' cafés & chocolatiers

Best time to visit Canton of Geneva

Best time to visit Canton of Geneva: May–Oct.
